scoringFormula: CompositeRisk = BaseSeverity * EpssMultiplier * ExposureMultiplier * ScopeMultiplier * ValidityMultiplier

P0.description: Critical emergency - Active secrets, runtime RCE/SQLi with internet exposure

P1.description: High priority - High severity production runtime vulnerabilities with patch available

P2.description: Medium priority - Standard vulnerabilities, direct dependencies without active exploits

P3.description: Low priority - Development dependencies, confirmed inactive secrets
